test_cases.description: initApp calls createAppRouter exactly once, then mountApp exactly once with the resulting router, mounting the app into #root
test_cases.setup_description: DOM element #root exists. createAppRouter and mountApp mocks are set up to succeed.
test_cases.expected_output_description: void — createAppRouter called once, mountApp called once after createAppRouter, in that order
assertions: createAppRouter is called before mountApp (call order)

test_cases.description: initApp throws missing_root_element error when DOM element #root does not exist
test_cases.setup_description: DOM body is empty — no #root element exists
assertions: initApp throws or mountApp propagates an error related to missing root element

test_cases.description: initApp propagates error when createAppRouter throws because a page component import is missing
test_cases.setup_description: DOM element #root exists. createAppRouter mock throws an error.
assertions: initApp throws/rejects with the router creation error
mountApp is never called when router creation fails

test_cases.description: initApp propagates error when mountApp throws because React root creation fails
test_cases.setup_description: DOM element #root exists. createAppRouter succeeds but mountApp throws.
assertions: initApp throws/rejects with the mount failure error
createAppRouter was still called exactly once before the failure

test_cases.description: initApp always calls createAppRouter before mountApp — order invariant
test_cases.setup_description: DOM element #root exists. Both mocks succeed and record call order.
test_cases.expected_output_description: createAppRouter invocation order index < mountApp invocation order index
assertions: createAppRouter call order is strictly before mountApp call order

test_cases.description: src/root.ts exports exactly one named runtime export: initApp
test_cases.setup_description: Import all exports from root module
test_cases.expected_output_description: Module has exactly one named export: initApp, which is a function
assertions: Module has exactly one named export key: 'initApp'

test_cases.description: main.tsx module side-effect calls initApp exactly once and imports CSS
test_cases.setup_description: Mock initApp from root module and CSS import. Dynamically import main.tsx.
test_cases.expected_output_description: initApp called exactly once, CSS import resolved
assertions: initApp is called exactly once upon module load

test_cases.description: main.tsx has zero named exports — it is a side-effect-only entry point
test_cases.setup_description: Mock initApp and CSS. Dynamically import main.tsx and inspect exports.
test_cases.expected_output_description: The module object has no named export keys (possibly only default undefined or empty)
assertions: Module export keys (excluding __esModule and default) is empty
